classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 15 owns device registry, lifecycle, command dispatch records and telemetry intake. Twin interpretation belongs to 16, provider protocol adapters remain external adapters, and planetary infrastructure belongs to 44.

areas.area: Devices have identity and ordered enrollment
areas.requirement: A device carries full identity material and enrollment cannot skip verification or claim identity before verification.

areas.area: Device lifecycle is a governed state machine
areas.requirement: Lifecycle transitions are ordered, illegal jumps are rejected and suspension/decommissioning require reasons.

areas.area: Telemetry is validated, calibrated and freshness-aware
areas.requirement: Telemetry rejects invalid values, units, future timestamps and stale or uncalibrated samples, while anomaly signals remain explicit.

areas.area: Commands are authorized, idempotent and safety-bounded
areas.requirement: Commands require metadata and authorization, high-impact actions require approval, safety stops block ordinary commands, and duplicate transmissions are detected.

areas.area: Firmware and device security have controlled rollout and recovery
areas.requirement: Unsigned or unverified production firmware is rejected, compatible rollout stages are ordered, rollback is ordered, credentials can be revoked and devices can be quarantined.

areas.area: Physical adapters and live telemetry remain unwired
areas.requirement: A provider adapter or live authorised boundary must register devices, dispatch commands and ingest telemetry; the cited evidence currently remains module and unit-suite evidence.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
